shortIntro.title: How to Run Genshin Impact Without Your Phone Crying
shortIntro.para1: Genshin Impact is like carrying Teyvat in your pocket. Stunning open-world visuals, epic elemental reactions, and mountains of particles mean your phone better be up to the task. Otherwise, expect lag, frame drops, and the occasional mobile meltdown.
shortIntro.para2: Low-end phones can survive at the lowest graphics with shrunken draw distances, while mid-range and flagship devices let you glide and battle at 40–60 FPS with gorgeous visuals. Bonus points if your device stays cool and has plenty of free storage—because nothing ruins a boss fight like your phone overheating.

intro: Here’s the verified list of minimum and recommended specs your Android phone needs to explore Teyvat smoothly without turning your adventure into a slideshow.

minimum.RAM: 3GB minimum (enough for one character and a chicken)
minimum.CPU: Snapdragon 660 / Kirin 710 / Helio P60 or equivalent
minimum.Internet: Stable 4G/WiFi connection for co-op and events

recommended.Internet: Low-latency 4G/5G or stable broadband for smooth co-op

ios_intro: Apple adventurers, your device needs to meet these specs for smooth exploration and high-speed gliding in Teyvat.
fps_intro: FPS (frames per second) in Genshin Impact is a little like elemental reactions—chaotic but satisfying if done right. Device tier, temperature, and map area (Sumeru rainforest vs. Mondstadt hills) all affect smoothness.

fps_list.fps: 20–30 FPS (may feel like walking through molasses)
45–60 FPS (with shadows and motion blur for max cinematic feels)

faqIntroText: Some common questions adventurers ask before diving into Teyvat:

faqList.question: Is Genshin Impact heavy on mobile?
faqList.answer: Absolutely. Beautiful open-world, tons of particle effects, and big textures require strong CPU/GPU performance.

faqList.question: Can I run Genshin Impact on 3GB RAM?
faqList.answer: Yes, but expect some loading pauses and lower graphics. Close background apps for a smoother adventure.

faqList.question: Does Genshin Impact support 60 FPS everywhere?
faqList.answer: Mostly on mid-range and flagship devices. Low-end phones might struggle to maintain 60 FPS in particle-heavy areas.
